'''Bent Fuglede''' (8 October 1925 – 7 December 2023) was a Danish mathematician.

== Early life and career ==
Fuglede was known for his contributions to mathematical analysis, in particular [[functional analysis]], where he proved [[Fuglede's theorem]] and stated [[Fuglede's conjecture]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Amiot|first1=E.|last2= Weisstein|first2=E.W.|title=Fuglede's Conjecture|url=http://mathworld.wolfram.com/FugledesConjecture.html|publisher=MathWorld--A Wolfram Web Resource.}}</ref>

Fuglede graduated from [[Skt. Jørgens Gymnasium]] 1943 and received his mag. scient. og cand. mag. in 1948 at the [[University of Copenhagen]] after which he studied in USA until 1951. In 1952 he was employed as scientific assistant at [[Den Polytekniske Læreanstalt]] and in 1954 as amanuensis at Matematisk Institut University of Copenhagen, in 1958 associate professor, and in 1959 head of department.<ref name=Pol>''70 år: Bent Fuglede'' Politiken, 7 October 1995, 1. sektion, Side 15</ref><ref name=Berl>''Matematik for viderekomne. 70 i dag'' Berlingske Tidende, 8 October 1995, 2.sekt, Magasin, Side 13</ref> Fuglede also spent one year in Lund (Sweden) as Nordic docent.<ref name=Berl /> Fuglede received his dr.phil. (Ph.D.) in 1960 from the University of Copenhagen; his [[doctoral advisor]] was [[Børge Jessen]],<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=54284}}</ref> after which he became professor of math at [[Danmarks tekniske Højskole]].  In 1965 he became professor of math at the University of Copenhagen, where he stayed until his retirement in 1992.

Fuglede was a member of the [[Royal Danish Academy of Sciences and Letters]],<ref>[http://www.royalacademy.dk/Medlemmer.aspx?ID=33&userid=521 Royal Academy webpage]</ref> the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>[http://www.acadsci.fi/jasenet/ulkomaiset_jasenet.htm Foreign members] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141009063143/http://www.acadsci.fi/jasenet/ulkomaiset_jasenet.htm |date=9 October 2014 }}, Finnish Academy of Science and Letters, retrieved 16 February 2010.</ref> and the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities|''Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften'']].<ref name=Berl /> In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 29 December 2012.</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Fuglede was married to [[Ólafía Einarsdóttir]], an Icelandic archeologist and historian. They had one child together, Einar.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bent Fuglede {{!}} lex.dk|url=https://biografiskleksikon.lex.dk/Bent_Fuglede|access-date=10 August 2020|website=Dansk Biografisk Leksikon|date=13 July 2012 |language=da}}</ref>

Bent Fuglede died in Copenhagen on 7 December 2023, at the age of 98.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bent Fuglede |url=https://afdoede.dk/en/memorial/315828/bent-fuglede |website=afdøde.dk |access-date=14 December 2023}}</ref>
